responsibility: This header defines the GNU/Hurd-specific AArch64 OS layer on top of the generic ELF port. It sets the Hurd dynamic linker path and linker emulation suffixes, provides `CPP_SPEC`, `CC1_SPEC`, `CC1PLUS_SPEC`, `LINK_SPEC`, and endfile math-runtime specs, installs GNU userland preprocessor builtins and exec-stack handling, and adjusts target policies such as symbol binding and static stack checking so AArch64 code is driven according to GNU/Hurd runtime conventions.
